findings.summary: 24 pages return noindex while linked from primary navigation
findings.detail: Pages reachable in two clicks from the homepage carry a noindex directive, so internal link equity terminates on them.
findings.recommendation: Remove the noindex directive or drop these URLs from primary navigation.
findings.evidence: Verified via crawl of 412 URLs; directive confirmed in the served HTML head.

findings.summary: Duplicate title tags across 11 category pages
findings.recommendation: Template titles to include the category name.
findings.evidence: Title tags extracted per URL and grouped; 11 exact-string collisions.
